findings.summary: On original labels, Thornbill-NER achieves a mean test F1 of 91.4% ± 0.4%, with a worst-seed F1 of 90.9% and a seed range of 0.9 points, compared to Lindgren-Tagger's 90.8% ± 0.5%, worst-seed 90.1%, and range 1.2 points.
findings.scope: Corvane-News NER test set, original training labels, 5 seeds, entity-level F1
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; differences in means and ranges are descriptive only.

findings.summary: The provided evidence does not include any experiments with label noise, so the research question of whether Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise cannot be answered from this package.
findings.scope: All experiments in package (exp1 only, original labels)
findings.caveats: No noise perturbation conditions or robustness comparisons were supplied.

drafts.passage: On the original Corvane-News NER labels, Thornbill-NER achieved a mean test F1 of 91.4% ± 0.4% with a worst-seed F1 of 90.9% and a seed range of 0.9 points, compared to Lindgren-Tagger's 90.8% ± 0.5%, worst-seed 90.1%, and range 1.2 points. These differences are descriptive only, as no statistical tests were reported. Because the package contains no experiments with label noise, the evidence does not address whether Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise in its training annotations.
